reference_answer:
## Cost basis
The verified cost base is ₹53,50,000. Board minimum margin is 8% and target margin is 10%. EMD is ₹1,20,000, PBG is 5%, and delivery is 45 days.

## Market evidence
No verified historical L1 data is available. The ₹75,00,000 estimate and L1 evaluation rule are tender facts, not competitor-price evidence. Do not invent a competitor quote or verified market benchmark.

## Price scenarios
| Scenario | Pre-GST | GST | Total | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum margin | ₹57,78,000 | ₹10,40,040 | ₹68,18,040 | 8% margin floor |
| Target margin | ₹58,85,000 | ₹10,59,300 | ₹69,44,300 | 10% target |
| 5% cost stress | ₹60,66,900 | ₹10,92,042 | ₹71,58,942 | 8% margin on ₹56,17,500 |

## Recommended quote
Recommend ₹69,44,300 including 18% GST. It is below the ₹75,00,000 estimate while preserving the verified 10% target margin. This is not a prediction of the winning L1 price.

## Sensitivity and approvals
If cost rises 5%, the cost base becomes ₹56,17,500 and the minimum-margin total becomes ₹71,58,942. Obtain board approval before pricing below ₹57,78,000 pre-GST. Confirm ₹1,20,000 EMD funding and the 5% PBG facility before submission.
